name: chat
changelog:
v5: the page follows the person's light or dark theme (D184, <html data-bx-theme="auto">), drawn from the workspace's tokens, fonts and 2px corners with drawn glyphs instead of emoji; a person's turn sits on the inset panel and the model's on the panel, a tool call is a mono block whose status is an icon and a word, and the thinking fold no longer animates; the native view's tools badge says "MCP errors" in words
v4: a model round that only calls tools no longer leaves an empty reply bubble above its tool cards; on a narrow tile (a phone) the top row wraps rather than cut New chat off
v3:a native view for the xbin app (native.js): the transcript, tool cards and composer drawn natively; the engine (models, MCP tools, streaming, the agent loop) moved from the page into chat-core.js, which the page and the native view share — the page behaves as before
title: Chat
description: A streaming LLM chat UI (foldable reasoning + MCP tool use). Pure frontend — bind one or more OpenAI-compatible LLM providers (e.g. llm-gw) and, optionally, Model Context Protocol servers whose tools the model can call.
